name: legal-billing-time-tracker
description: Legal Billing and Time Tracker — Claude Desktop extension for solo attorneys to track time, generate invoices, and manage trust accounts via natural conversation

scripts.pack: npm run install:server && rm -f /tmp/legal-billing-time-tracker.zip && (cd plugin && zip -r /tmp/legal-billing-time-tracker.zip . -x '*.DS_Store' '*/node_modules/.cache/*' 'package-lock.json') && mv /tmp/legal-billing-time-tracker.zip ./legal-billing-time-tracker-v$npm_package_version.mcpb
scripts.build: npm run validate && npm run pack && npm run checksum
scripts.release: npm run build && gh release create v$npm_package_version legal-billing-time-tracker-v$npm_package_version.mcpb legal-billing-time-tracker-v$npm_package_version.mcpb.sha256 --title "v$npm_package_version" --notes-file RELEASE.md
scripts.pack:cowork: rm -f ./legal-billing.plugin && (cd cowork-plugin && zip -r ../legal-billing.plugin . -x '*.DS_Store') && echo "Built legal-billing.plugin ($(du -sh ./legal-billing.plugin | cut -f1))"
